items.stem: What is the difference between two successive sums of 5 consecutive numbers?
What is the total quantity of fuel in a lorry if it has 28 litres and 75 litres are added?
What is the total amount spent by Mahesh and his family on fuel and other expenses, if they spent ₹21,880 on fuel and ₹38,900 on other expenses?
What is the total distance of the sea route from Mumbai to Chennai?
What is the total distance of the North–South Corridor in 2019, if one of the places on it was 1,855 km from Srinagar and 1,862 km from Kanniyakumari?
What is the remaining distance the ship has to travel to reach Chennai after reaching Cochin?
What is the difference between the longest land route and the longest highway in Africa?
What is the sum of 49 and 89?
What is the total money Mary has left after her trip to Delhi?
What is the total weight loaded on the truck?
What is the total number of certificates printed in Chittoor, A.P. and Raigad, Maharashtra?
What is the difference in height between the highest and lowest peaks Priyanka Mohite climbed?
What is the total amount the school council needs to spend on the Maths Lab, library books, and sports equipment?

If Priyanka was 20 years old when she summited Mount Everest in 2013, in which year was she born?

Which is the highest peak Priyanka Mohite climbed according to the table?

In which year was Priyanka Mohite born if she was 20 years old when she summited Mount Everest in 2013?
For what number of presses will the torch be ON?

If 2,009 certificates are printed and 7,388 students attend, how many certificates are in excess?
Mary starts her train journey from Kolkata with ₹12,540. She spends ₹3,275 on food, ₹2,645 on a train ticket, and ₹1,275 on souvenirs. How much money is she left with?
What number should be added to 32 to get 100?
If a minibus has 18 litres of fuel and after refuelling it has 65 litres, how much fuel was filled?
A lorry has 28 litres of fuel in its tank. An additional 75 litres is filled. What is the total quantity of fuel in the lorry?
A ship travels from Mumbai to Chennai via Cochin. The total distance is 2,700 km, and it travels 1,083 km to Cochin. How much more distance does it need to travel to reach Chennai?
The longest land route is 15,150 km, and the longest highway in Africa is 10,228 km. By how much is the land route longer than the highway?
A truck can carry 8,250 kg of goods. It loads 3,675 kg of cement and 2,850 kg of steel. How much more weight can the truck carry before reaching its maximum capacity?
